scope: Read-only review of the complete C probe, supervisor, and selected-member restorer against the frozen plan. Review-file creation only; no canonical or fabricated probe reruns.

review_findings.input_identity_and_chronology: The supervisor binds the plan and passing contract review, published source Git blobs, executable receipt/binary, original source identities, and four selected member SHA256/byte counts. The C codec validates checkpoint identity/configuration. All three checkpoint indices and exact archived next observations are validated before any propagation; n consumes observation n to produce endpoint n+1.
review_findings.linear_reference: The C calculation uses the full transition Jacobian at the saved center, the voltage gradient at the propagated center, and the complete packed lower factor. Independent chain-gradient and propagated-factor products are compared. Latent variance is the projected-factor squared norm; the fixed observation variance is added once.
review_findings.node_and_covariance_rule: The C probe uses all 32 column nodes mu +/- 4 L[:,k] with equal weight 1/32, including repeated nodes. The reducer independently checks every node formula and reconstructs all 16 means and 136 lower-triangle covariance entries from the complete intended node set, including nodes rejected for propagation.
review_findings.domain_and_invalid_rules: All 16 pre coordinates and successful post-step states receive public-bound checks. Physical-step errors retain attempted SOC/model status and no fabricated post-state. Any invalid node makes the entire component moment rule unavailable. The reducer rejects survivor moments or changed weights and reconciles individual, component and global admission/propagation counts.
review_findings.moment_reduction: For fully admitted components, independent stable sums reconstruct the nonlinear voltage mean and population variance, observation-noise addition, and signed changes relative to the physical and production-order centers. Frozen numerical mismatches disable interpretation.
review_findings.bounded_moment_check: The reducer computes each saved marginal variance from its complete factor row, cap=(b-mu)(mu-a), and excess using the frozen 128*DBL_EPSILON*(b-a)^2 comparison allowance. It does not repair, truncate or project the moments.
review_findings.resource_and_attempt_accounting: A new exclusive output directory reserves the single attempt. The exact probe child is reaped with wait4, independently of earlier git/compiler children. CPU, address-space, file-size, core-dump and wall restrictions are set; combined stdout/stderr retention is capped. Probe RSS, supervisor RSS, counters and self-inclusive derived-output bytes are recorded separately.
review_findings.failure_and_immutability: Preflight and execution failures retain failure records; numerical or resource failures suppress scientific eligibility. All bound input/source/binary files are rehashed after the attempt. No automatic retry, learner ingestion, old scorer, source generation or truth input is introduced.
review_findings.restoration: The restorer requires a new destination outside the repository, validates frozen source/index identities and exactly four selected members, verifies every archive part and the concatenated archive through the preserved helper, checks member metadata and selected SHA256/Git-blob/byte identities, consumes the XZ footer, and preserves the original primary evidence.

qualification_evidence_reviewed.description: Recorded successful C compile with strict warning flags and fabricated affine-voltage, zero-covariance, dense-factor, pre/post-domain, derivative, wrong-index and unchanged-component checks. Maximum derivative error 1.0827225782605865e-9 against 2e-8; maximum dense variance error 1.974183131236946e-16. These are separately recorded fabricated calls, not canonical calls.

Reviewed the two preserved historical inline scripts and observed outputs for 12 fabricated supervisor checks, including strict JSON, noise once, bounded-moment and invalid-rule behavior, combined output cap, exact-child usage, deadline termination, prelaunch failure retention, output-byte closure and no overwrite. No qualification was rerun by this reviewer.

interpretation_limits: A bounded scalar-moment violation disproves that bounded-support interpretation; a pass is only necessary and does not establish joint feasibility or coverage.
Finite-node admission is not a Gaussian support or calibration test; invalid-node counts are not probability estimates.
The one-step sensitivity scales are frozen prioritization scales. Small differences do not bound accumulated sequential-likelihood effects.
A later boundary failure does not establish the cause of the earlier component-weight switch.
Exact-child peak RSS includes fork/exec setup, as disclosed. Canonical resource sufficiency remains an execution result, not a claim from fabricated checks.
remaining_gate: Root must publish these exact reviewed implementation sources and bind the qualified executable before the single canonical invocation. Completed canonical results still require independent result review.
